title: What If the Moon Came 10x Closer?

hook.text:
WHAT IF THE MOON
CAME 10× CLOSER?

segments.text: What if the Moon came ten times closer?
Cut that in half, and the tides get eight times stronger.
Now bring it ten times closer. It would fill your sky.
And its pull on the oceans? A thousand times stronger. Coastal cities would flood.
The squeezing would crack the ground and wake up volcanoes.
Closer than 18,000 kilometers, and Earth's gravity tears the Moon apart.
Its rubble would wrap our planet in rings.
Luckily, the Moon is drifting away, almost four centimeters every year.
